properties.name: Russian-occupied mainland Ukraine
properties.note: Covers most of Luhansk oblast, much of Donetsk, southern Zaporizhzhia and the left bank of Kherson oblast. Roughly a fifth of Ukraine's internationally recognised territory is under Russian control when Crimea is included.

properties.name: Crimea
properties.note: Annexed in 2014 in a move most of the international community does not recognise. Home to Sevastopol and the historic headquarters of the Black Sea Fleet, much of which has since relocated east to Novorossiysk under Ukrainian strike pressure.
